issues.element: Global header utility cluster (refresh / globe / sign-out) at top right. Its bordered box still overhangs the content column's right edge: about 32px at 2293 (box ~2275 vs card edge ~2243), ~25px at 1366 (1341 vs 1316), ~32px at 1680 (1655 vs 1623), ~14px at 1024 (999 vs 985). It is also ~52px tall against 32px toolbar controls. At 1440 it lines up, so the right inset is inconsistent between widths.
issues.fix: Give the header cluster the same right inset as the content column at every width so its right edge matches the toolbar and KPI card edge, and size its buttons to the 32px control height (or drop the outer border so it reads as page chrome).

issues.element: Flat-trend baselines in KPI tiles (Failed events, Cache-write tokens, Reported reasoning tokens, Priced/Unpriced events). Each stretches from the number to the tile edge: ~205px at 1440 Failed events against ~147px sparklines in the neighbouring tiles, and ~480px at 2293 Cost Priced/Unpriced. Sparklines in the same row have a fixed width, so the flat ones read as a different component.
issues.fix: Draw flat baselines in the same fixed-width, right-aligned sparkline slot as the live sparklines, with the same start x in every tile of the row.

issues.element: Flat baselines in the Cache-write tokens and Reported reasoning tokens tiles are drawn in neutral grey, while every other token sparkline on the tab is violet. That breaks 'violet = token metrics'. Failed events correctly uses red.
issues.fix: Draw the token-tile flat baselines in the violet token ink, at reduced opacity if they need to look quieter.

issues.element: KPI rows have unequal heights. Row 1 is ~93px because Uncached input tokens has a 'No range total' footnote; row 2 is ~80px with no footnotes. Overview tiles are ~101px with a footnote row. Tile height changes between rows and between tabs.
issues.fix: Give every KPI tile a fixed three-row anatomy (label / value+sparkline / footnote, with the footnote row reserved even when empty) so tile height is the same on every row and tab.

issues.element: Segmented view tabs change width on selection because the selected label is bold. At 1440 the tab group ends at x=913 on Overview and x=918 on Tokens & Cache. At 390 the selected 'Tokens & Cache' wraps to two lines while the unselected label fits on one, so the tab grid row grows.
issues.fix: Reserve bold width for each tab label (e.g. a hidden bold duplicate or a fixed min-width), or show selection by the lifted surface alone without the weight change.

issues.element: KPI tile labels wrap to 2–3 lines ('p95 execution duration · ms', 'Reported output tokens', 'Estimated cost · USD'), which pushes those tiles' numbers down. At 1024, 2,400 sits at y≈288 against 128 at y≈282, and 14.5M at y≈416 against 3.5B at y≈412. On Estimated cost the sparkline drops under the number, making that row taller. At 320 the 2-column tiles have 3-line labels.
issues.fix: Reserve two label lines (min-height) in every tile so values share a baseline across the row. Below ~360px, switch the KPI grid to one column.

issues.element: Search field placeholder is clipped ('Model or request referenc') because the field shrinks to ~210px next to Apply and three selects.
issues.fix: Below ~900px, put the search on its own full-width row above the three selects (the reference idiom), or shorten the placeholder.

issues.element: Toolbar Apply button is a mid-grey fill with dark text (1440: x 687–751) in data states but dark in the error state. With white-filled Retry and dark Refresh, that is three filled-button treatments, and the mid-grey reads as disabled.
issues.fix: Use one primary style (the white Retry treatment) for Apply when there is a pending query and the standard dark secondary style otherwise, with a clearly dimmed disabled style.

issues.element: KPI row: three tiles about 640px wide each at 2293. Priced events and Unpriced events hold a 3-digit number plus a ~480px flat line; the tile is mostly empty.
issues.fix: Cap KPI tile width at the Overview tile width (~240–260px at 2293) and left-pack the tiles, or let the Cost note card share the row to the right of the tiles.

issues.element: Cost note card still ends with a bare fragment, 'Legacy cache-write lifetime unavailable', under the explanatory sentence (unchanged from r13).
issues.fix: Fold it into the sentence ('…; cache-write cost for legacy events is excluded because their lifetime is unknown.') or move it under a 'Measurement details' disclosure like Tokens and Performance.

issues.element: Model Rates table: the right-aligned Cache write values end ~14–16px before the left-aligned 'Rate details' column ($3.75 ends at x≈1220, 'Rate details' starts at x≈1236 at 1440), so they read as one cluster (unchanged from r13).
issues.fix: Add a gutter of at least 32px before Rate details, or right-align the Rate details disclosure to the table's right edge.

issues.element: The card heading 'Model Rates' is Title Case, but every other card heading is sentence case ('Usage trend', 'Cost trend', 'Token trend', 'Requests').
issues.fix: Use 'Model rates' for the card heading. The tab label can stay as-is if tabs are deliberately Title Case ('Tokens & Cache').

issues.element: The time-range and bucket segmented groups stay fully active on Model Rates, though the note says these are current configured rates, not historical, so the controls do nothing here.
issues.fix: Dim the range and bucket groups (with a 'Not time-based' hint), or hide them on the Model Rates tab.

issues.element: Card header: '128 retained events' sits ~6px lower than the 'Requests' title (1440: 264 vs 258), so the two don't share a baseline. At 1440 the 'Usage presence reported' sub-label wraps to 2 lines under every token value.
issues.fix: Baseline-align the count with the title. Shorten the sub-label to 'Usage reported' or let the token column take the width.

issues.element: At 390, Performance KPI tiles stack one per row, Overview and Tokens use two columns, and Cost uses 1 + 2. The same tile component uses three mobile layouts.
issues.fix: Use one mobile KPI rule (two columns at ≥360px, one below) on every tab; the long Performance labels can wrap to two reserved lines.

issues.element: The p95 reported TTFT chart card is full width and ~410px tall at 1440 for sparse 2-point segments, about 70% empty plot. At 2293 the two charts sit side by side.
issues.fix: From ~1280px, put Duration and TTFT side by side as at 2293, or give the TTFT card a shorter plot height (~180px) because it is secondary.

issues.element: The empty message says 'Choose a longer range to look further back' but has no action, so the user must go back to the toolbar.
issues.fix: Add an inline secondary button (e.g. 'Show last 7 days') under the message, styled like Retry on the error state.

issues.element: All three KPI tiles say 'Unavailable / No range total', and both chart cards say 'No measured values in this interval.' Neither says why durations are missing or what to do.
issues.fix: Show one explanation above the tiles (e.g. 'No events in this range recorded execution timing — older events may predate timing capture; try a recent range'), and reduce the per-tile footnote to '—' or omit it.

issues.element: The error state has three refresh affordances (header refresh icon, toolbar Refresh, card Retry), and the filters stay fully interactive although nothing can load.
issues.fix: Keep Retry as the single action: dim toolbar Refresh and the filter controls while the dataset is unavailable, or hide the toolbar's second row.

issues.element: Skeletons don't match the loaded layout. At 2293 the skeleton KPI tiles are ~101px against ~132px loaded, and the skeleton chart card is ~377px against ~446px loaded, so content jumps on load. The skeletons are blank boxes with no label/value placeholders, and at 390 the chart skeleton is far taller than the real chart.
issues.fix: Size skeleton tiles and the chart skeleton from the same height tokens as the loaded components, and add label/value/sparkline placeholder bars inside each tile so the skeleton previews the anatomy.

issues.element: 'By model' card: the very long model name wraps to 2 lines, so its bar sits ~15px lower than the first bar in the neighbouring 'By provider' card, and the card has ~50px of dead space above 'View data table'.
issues.fix: Truncate model names to one line with an ellipsis and a title tooltip (full name in the data table), so rows line up across the two cards.

regressions: Apply button changed from the dark secondary style (r13) to a mid-grey fill with dark text that reads as disabled. It is now a third filled-button treatment alongside white Retry and dark Refresh.
Tokens: replacing 'Flat trend' text with grey full-width baselines fixed the tile anatomy but dropped the violet token ink on Cache-write and Reported reasoning tiles.

No layout regressions elsewhere. The 1366 header cluster no longer overlaps the toolbar card, the Rates note bar is now full width, Clear filters gained an x icon, and the first chart remains fully visible on load at 2293, 1920, 1680, 1440, 1366, 1280 and 3440.
reference_gaps: Search and filters: the reference puts search on its own full-width row and the filters on an equal-width row beneath it. Prox squeezes search, an Apply button and three selects into one row, which clips the placeholder at 768. The reference also searches live, with no Apply.

Filter dropdowns look like native <select> elements (browser chevron and padding), while the reference uses custom dropdowns with an aligned chevron. They don't match the custom segmented pills beside them.
No auto-refresh interval indicator next to Refresh (the reference shows a '(6s)' status chip).
Range group has no 'Custom' option, and the bucket group offers only Auto / Hourly / Daily (the reference also has finer buckets).
Control heights differ slightly: view tabs ~35px, range/bucket groups ~32px, search/selects ~31px at 1440. The reference keeps segmented groups and buttons at one height.
The view tabs sit in the same card as the filters without the reference's separating band or divider, so the view switch and the filters read with nearly equal weight.
